content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Raebareli
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Raebareli is an autonomous institute under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India, located at Munshiganj, Raebareli. The post is in its Department of Physiology (Integrative Neurophysiology Lab). It serves the research project "Aspartame and Neurotoxicity: A Neurobiology and Translational Genomics Study", funded by CSIR-HRDG, New Delhi under the CSIR-HRDG Research Scheme (File No. 60(0126)/26/EMR-II).

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: One Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post has been sanctioned. The project is led by Dr. Arbind Kumar Choudhary, Associate Professor, Department of Physiology, AIIMS Raebareli (Principal Investigator). The Co-PIs are Dr. Sanjay Yadav, Prof and HOD, Department of Biochemistry, AIIMS Raebareli, and Dr. Prem N. Yadav, Principal Scientist, CSIR-CDRI, Lucknow. The notice lists a valid CSIR-UGC NET (LS) and GATE qualification as "(Desirable)". The documents list asks for a valid CSIR-UGC NET (JRF) certificate or scorecard. The age limit for JRF is not more than 28 years, as per the revised CSIR JRF-NET guidelines (w.e.f. 01.03.2023). The notice prints no date for counting age. The upper age limit is relaxable up to 5 years for candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), women and physically handicapped (PwD) candidates. The JRF fellowship is Rs. 37,000/- per month for the first two years, plus HRA as admissible under CSIR norms. On Ph.D. registration within two years and satisfactory assessment by the Expert Committee, the fellow may be upgraded to SRF at Rs. 42,000/- per month from the third year. The notice says upgradation is subject to Ph.D. registration and assessment by a three-member Expert Committee. No application fee applies: the notice lists the fee as Nil. The project tenure is 36 months from the date of commencement. The fellowship is co-terminus with the project and the post is purely temporary.

rows.pay: Rs. 37,000/- per month for the first two years, plus HRA as admissible under CSIR norms

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raebareli Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice describes the work as full-time work on the project, covering: Animal handling and neuro-behavioural studies Molecular biology techniques (RNA/DNA extraction, RT-PCR, western blot, immunohistochemistry) Cognitive and EEG/ERP assessments Sample collection and storage Data entry and analysis Coordination with CSIR-CDRI, Lucknow, and report writing

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The notice says interested candidates with the stated eligibility can appear directly for the walk-in interview. The documents to bring are: Filled CSIR Form-G application (given on page 4 of the notice) Photo identity proof (Aadhaar card/ Driving Licence/ Voter ID card/ PAN card/ Passport) Address proof Proof of date of birth (10th Certificate/ Birth certificate) One recent passport size photograph Relevant mark sheets and certificates (10th, 12th, Bachelor's and Master's degree) Valid CSIR-UGC NET (JRF) certificate / scorecard Category certificate (OBC-NCL/SC/ST/EWS/PwD), if applicable Experience certificates clearly showing date of joining and relieving, if any Original certificates and one set of self-attested photocopies must be produced. Without them the candidate will not be allowed to participate in the interview. A candidate already in service must submit a No Objection Certificate from the present employer at the time of interview. Form-G is the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research application form for Junior/Senior Research Fellowships under a CSIR Research Scheme. It asks for: Name, present and permanent address, date of birth, nationality and father's/husband's name Whether the applicant belongs to SC/ST/OBC, with the certificate enclosed Educational qualifications from Bachelor's degree onwards, in a table of degree, university, subject, year of passing, division/grade and marks % Whether registered for a higher degree, or proposing to register Research or teaching experience, previous research fellowships, and publications with reprints or copies attached A signed declaration that the candidate will work whole time on the research under the Principal Investigator The form also has an attestation section for the Principal Investigator and the Head of the Institution.

faq.question: Q1. When is the AIIMS Raebareli JRF walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 20 November 2026, with reporting time 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the AIIMS Raebareli JRF walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: The venue is the Department of Physiology, 2nd Floor, Medical College Block, AIIMS Raebareli. The institute address is Munshiganj, Raebareli – 229405, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q3. How many JRF vacancies are there at AIIMS Raebareli?
faq.answer: There is 1 (One) vacancy for Junior Research Fellow (JRF), as sanctioned.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the AIIMS Raebareli JRF post?
faq.answer: A Master's degree life sciences or equivalent (CSIR/UGC norms) with at least 55% marks (50% for OBC-NCL/SC/ST/PwD/Third gender). A valid CSIR-UGC NET (LS) and GATE qualification is marked "(Desirable)".

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the AIIMS Raebareli JRF post?
faq.answer: The age limit is not more than 28 years. It is relaxable up to 5 years for SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), women and PwD candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the fellowship for the AIIMS Raebareli JRF?
faq.answer: The JRF fellowship is Rs. 37,000/- per month for the first two years, plus HRA as admissible under CSIR norms. SRF upgradation to Rs. 42,000/- per month from the third year is possible on conditions.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid in addition to the JRF fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice says Rs. 37,000/- per month plus HRA as admissible under CSIR norms.

faq.question: Q8. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No. The notice lists the application fee as Nil.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Bring the filled CSIR Form-G, photo identity proof, address proof, date of birth proof, one passport size photograph, mark sheets and certificates, the CSIR-UGC NET (JRF) certificate or scorecard, a category certificate if applicable, and experience certificates if any. Originals and one set of self-attested photocopies are required.

faq.question: Q10. Is the AIIMS Raebareli JRF job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely temporary and contractual, co-terminus with the CSIR-sanctioned project of 36 months, and gives no right to regular appointment or permanent absorption.
